ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
  REVOLVING LOAN SUBCOMMITTEE AGENDA

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  MEMORIAL HEIGHTS CONFERENCE ROOM, 10TH FL., 1:45 PM

Austin Metoyer, Commissioner
Jayro Sandoval, Commissioner
Brenda Wunsch, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  CARLA.HENDY-ANGUIANO@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54240 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee meeting of Wednesday, December 3,
  2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54249 Recommendation to approve the revolving loan application in the amount of $99,000,
  for Ashkan Namini DDS Inc. dba Ash Dental Studio located at 930 Pacific Avenue,
  Long Beach, CA 90813.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54250 Recommendation to approve the revolving loan application in the amount of $35,000,
  for Gildardo Osuna dba VTTR A Tax And Accounting Company located at 5360 Long
  Beach Boulevard, Long Beach, CA 90805.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54251 Recommendation to approve the revolving loan application in the amount of $50,000,
  for Avy & Monkey, LLC dba Val's Vegan Kitchen located at 2650 East Broadway,
  Long Beach, CA 90803.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
extended by the Chair.
